ct as (
  select cif_no, max(contact_dt) last_contact,
         max_by(banker_id, contact_dt) last_banker, max_by(banker_role, contact_dt) last_role, max_by(channel, contact_dt) last_channel

select c.cif_no, c.client_nm, c.state, c.rm_id, r.rm_nm, r.team, f.n_fac, f.active_commit,
       ct.last_contact, datediff(day, ct.last_contact, '2026-09-30'::date) days_since, ct.last_banker, ct.last_role, ct.last_channel

join fac f on f.cif_no=c.cif_no

sql.sql:
select 'seg' k, segment_cd v, count(*) n from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'cstat', client_status, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'fstat', facility_status, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 2
union all select 'role', banker_role, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'chan', channel, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen_client', length(cif_no)::string, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen_contact', length(cif_no)::string, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 2
union all select 'ciflen_fac', length(cif_no)::string, count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 2
order by 1,2
select min(contact_dt), max(contact_dt), count(*), count(distinct contact_id), sum(iff(contact_dt>'2026-09-30',1,0)) future, sum(iff(contact_dt is null,1,0)) nulls from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT;
select count(*), count(distinct cif_no), count(distinct trim(cif_no)) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT

select facility_status, 
 sum(iff(payoff_dt is not null,1,0)) has_payoff, sum(iff(chgoff_dt is not null,1,0)) has_chgoff,
 sum(iff(maturity_dt < '2026-09-30',1,0)) matured, sum(iff(commit_amt is null or commit_amt<=0,1,0)) bad_amt,
 sum(iff(orig_dt > '2026-09-30',1,0)) future_orig,
 count(*), count(distinct facility_id)
from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY group by 1

select iff(f.maturity_dt < '2026-09-30','matured','not_matured') m, count(*) n,
 sum(iff(b.facility_id is not null,1,0)) has_sep_snap,
 sum(iff(b.drawn_amt+b.undrawn_amt between f.commit_amt-1 and f.commit_amt+1,1,0)) bal_eq_commit
from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f
left join BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY_BAL_MTHLY b on b.facility_id=f.facility_id and b.snap_dt='2026-09-30'
where f.facility_status='ACTIVE' group by 1

select (select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT c where not exists (select 1 from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT k where k.cif_no=c.cif_no)) orphan_contacts,
(select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY f where not exists (select 1 from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT k where k.cif_no=f.cif_no)) orphan_fac,
(select count(distinct banker_id) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT where banker_role='RM' and banker_id not in (select rm_id from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER)) rm_not_in_roster,
(select count(*) from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT where rm_id is null or rm_id not in (select rm_id from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER)) client_bad_rm

with fac as (
  select cif_no, sum(commit_amt) active_commit, count(*) n_fac
  from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' group by 1),
ct as (
  select cif_no, max(contact_dt) last_contact,
         max_by(banker_id, contact_dt) last_banker, max_by(banker_role, contact_dt) last_role, max_by(channel, contact_dt) last_channel
  from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 1)
select c.cif_no, c.client_nm, c.state, c.rm_id, r.rm_nm, r.team, f.n_fac, f.active_commit,
       ct.last_contact, datediff(day, ct.last_contact, '2026-09-30'::date) days_since, ct.last_banker, ct.last_role, ct.last_channel
from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c
join fac f on f.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join ct on ct.cif_no=c.cif_no
left join BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_ROSTER r on r.rm_id=c.rm_id
where c.segment_cd='LC' and c.client_status='ACTIVE' and f.active_commit > 25000000
  and (ct.last_contact is null or ct.last_contact < dateadd(day,-90,'2026-09-30'::date))
order by f.active_commit desc

with fac as (select cif_no, sum(commit_amt) a from BANK_DEMO.LENDING.FACILITY where facility_status='ACTIVE' group by 1),
ct as (select cif_no, max(contact_dt) lc from BANK_DEMO.CORE.RM_CONTACT group by 1)
select count(*) lc_clients,
 sum(iff(f.a>25000000,1,0)) lc_gt25,
 sum(iff(f.a=25000000,1,0)) lc_eq25,
 sum(iff(f.a=25000000 and (ct.lc is null or ct.lc < '2026-07-02'),1,0)) eq25_no_contact,
 sum(iff(f.a>25000000 and ct.lc is null,1,0)) gt25_never_contacted,
 sum(iff(f.a>25000000 and (ct.lc is null or ct.lc<'2026-07-02'),f.a,0)) uncontacted_commit,
 sum(iff(f.a>25000000,f.a,0)) total_gt25_commit
from BANK_DEMO.CORE.CLIENT c left join fac f on f.cif_no=c.cif_no left join ct on ct.cif_no=c.cif_no
where c.segment_cd='LC'
